Priya: Morning team — quick triage check. Queue: 58 (↑8), P1s: 6 (two new), awaiting-customer: 12. Billing webhook spike looks lower but still elevated. Known issues: embeddings indexing latency (investigating with eng-ml), refunds flow causing duplicate charges occasionally. Macros: need version bump for billing-refund (adds new refund reason codes) and a new macro for 'escalate-invoice' that attaches invoice + priority tag. @Sam can you take macros PR? Also who can own P1s for morning shift?

Sam: I can take P1s until 11:30 PT. I'll review macro PR now. PR: https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/42 :thumbsup: 

Jules: I'll take the embeddings ticket with eng-ml. Filed INF-1243 with logs. Expect first analysis in ~90m.

Kai: I'll scrub the queue for acme & beta-inc, push hotfix to attach invoice id in escalation macro. Quick question: do we want 'escalate-invoice' to CC finance@redwood.com or tag them? Leaning CC for now.

Priya: CC finance for now. Also add a short template line in macro: 'account manager: <name>' so we don't have to hunt. Here's a snippet for macro body:

```text
Customer: {{customer}}
Invoice: {{invoice_id}}
Priority: P1
Account manager: {{owner}}
Action: escalate to finance
```

Put that in the PR.

Sam: Added snippet + unit tests. Running linter, pushed commit. CI still queued.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: Production deploy finished at 2024-04-16T09:12:00Z — no errors. Service: billing-webhook, version: v2.3.1

Jules: Heads up: noticed increased 5xxs on embeddings-indexer around 08:45 UTC, correlated with nightly reindex job. Will add rate-limit on reindex. I'll post infra ticket.

Kai: Taking acme beta tickets now. If anyone sees customer DMs, tag me.

Priya: Thanks all. If anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall. I'll update triage doc and macros list after PR merges. /remind @Sam in 1h to confirm P1 handoff.
